claims.text: Intermediate-risk NMIBC: consider a 6-week induction course of BCG, or intravesical chemo w mitomycin C, doxorubicin or epirubicin.
claims.quote: Intermediate-risk NMIBC urothelial cancers should be considered for a 6-week induction course of Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) immunotherapy or intravesical chemotherapy with mitomycin C, doxorubicin, or epirubicin.
